topic: ClickHouse version rollback and stability testing
summary_markdown:
The session focused on troubleshooting connectivity issues related to ZooKeeper and stabilizing the ClickHouse cluster. Initial attempts to restart services failed due to `Connection refused` errors connecting to ZooKeeper nodes.

Multiple version changes were tested, including an upgrade to 22.3 (which was found unstable) and subsequent downgrades/rollbacks. The team ultimately decided to roll back the production environment to version 21.12.3.32 and test the sandbox on 22.2.3.1.

The system demonstrated data flow between nodes, although some temporary data imbalance was noted in the raw tables. The primary goal of ensuring stable data ingestion across all nodes was achieved by the end of the session.
decisions: The production ClickHouse environment will be rolled back to version 21.12.3.32.
The sandbox environment will be tested on version 22.2.3.1.
action_items: Monitor the cluster for stable data ingestion and check for potential issues with ClickHouse-Keeper implementation in future upgrades.
